description: This Python script automates the processing and generation of code snippets for enum types in C/C++ source files. It reads source files, detects enum, class, and struct definitions, and generates corresponding string conversion functions and operator overloads, inserting them into the source code. It also manages configuration settings and file handling for batch processing.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for the script, including test modes, formatting strings, and output handling.

classes.name: EnumMetadata
classes.description: Stores metadata about detected enum types, including name, values, and context (class, header file).

classes.name: Coordinate
classes.description: Represents a specific position in source code by line and character index.

classes.name: CodePosition
classes.description: Tracks the position and bracket balance of enum, class, or struct definitions within source files.

methods.name: to_number
methods.description: Converts various number representations (hex, octal, float, ASCII) to a numeric value.

methods.name: get_enum_metadata
methods.description: Extracts enum metadata from source code based on position data and lines.

methods.name: add_generated_code
methods.description: Generates and inserts string conversion functions and operator overloads for enums into source code.

methods.name: upgrade_enum
methods.description: Main function that processes a source file to detect enums and generate corresponding code snippets.

methods.name: get_files_list
methods.description: Recursively collects source files from a workspace, excluding specified paths.

methods.name: redirect_stdout_to_file
methods.description: Redirects stdout to a log file.

methods.name: read_configuration
methods.description: Reads and applies configuration settings from a JSON file, including workspace paths and exclusions.
